title: Zero-Shot Adaptation of Medical Vision Foundation Models for High-Frequency Micro-Ultrasound Prostate Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2608.14796v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Prostate cancer claims a life every 80 seconds. Early detection is needed to prevent disease progression, and both PSA density calculation and biopsy decisions rely on knowing the exact boundary of the gland. Conventional ultrasound at 6-12 MHz blurs this boundary, missing one in three high-risk cancers. Micro-ultrasound (29 MHz) improves resolution threefold but introduces dense acoustic speckle that obscures the outer wall; given the same image, two clinicians draw outlines differing by over 10% in area. Supervised methods are costly and generalise poorly across scanners. Can a foundation model segment the prostate with no training data?   We present the first zero-shot pipeline for this modality: MedSAM, pre-trained on over 1.5 million medical images, localises the prostate; we then apply CLAHE to sharpen the outer wall, binary dilation to recover missed pixels, and Fourier smoothing (4 modes, s=1.05) to refine the boundary. MedSAM

translated_title: 医学视觉基础模型在高频微超声前列腺分割中的零样本适应
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.14796v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：前列腺癌每80秒夺走一条生命。早期检测对于防止疾病进展至关重要，而PSA密度计算和活检决策都依赖于准确了解腺体的边界。传统的6-12 MHz超声会使这一边界模糊，漏掉三分之一的高风险癌症。微超声（29 MHz）将分辨率提高三倍，但引入了密集的声学散斑，遮蔽了外壁；面对同一图像，两位临床医生勾画的轮廓面积差异超过10%。监督方法成本高昂且在不同扫描仪间泛化能力差。基础模型能否在没有训练数据的情况下分割前列腺？我们提出了针对该模态的首个零样本流程：MedSAM，在超过150万张医学图像上预训练，定位前列腺；随后我们应用CLAHE锐化外壁，使用二值膨胀恢复遗漏像素，并通过傅里叶平滑（4个模式，s=1.05）细化边界。
tldr: 本文首次提出零样本流程，利用预训练的MedSAM基础模型结合CLAHE、二值膨胀和傅里叶平滑，无需训练数据即可实现微超声前列腺分割，克服了传统超声边界模糊和散斑干扰的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first zero-shot pipeline using the pre-trained MedSAM foundation model combined with CLAHE, binary dilation, and Fourier smoothing to achieve micro-ultrasound prostate segmentation without training data, overcoming challenges of blurred boundaries and speckle interference in conventional ultrasound.
